client: Hi Luna, I've been feeling really intense loneliness since my breakup a few weeks ago. It’s like this heavy weight on my chest that just doesn’t go away. I keep thinking about all the things we used to do together, and it makes me feel even more isolated. I’m not sure if talking about it will really help, but I guess I just want to figure out how to cope with this feeling.
therapist:
Hi there! It sounds like you're really navigating a tough time with your feelings of loneliness after the breakup. That heavy weight on your chest can be so overwhelming, especially when memories of what you used to share come flooding back. 

It's completely understandable to feel isolated when you’re going through something like this. I’m glad you’re open to talking about it, even if you’re unsure it will help. Sometimes just sharing what’s on your mind can create a little space to breathe. 

I wonder if there are deeper layers to this loneliness that you might not be fully expressing. It’s okay to feel a mix of emotions, and sometimes it’s hard to pinpoint exactly what we’re experiencing. What do you think? Are there other feelings that come up for you when you think about your breakup or your situation now?
vocal_descriptors: very high pitch, soft-spoken, moderate-paced speech

client: I appreciate you saying that, Luna. When I think about the breakup, I feel this mix of sadness and anger, but I also feel so much guilt. I don’t really know how to express all of this, and even if I could, I'm not sure it would change anything.
therapist:

It's understandable to replay those moments and wonder if there was something you could have done differently. Those feelings can be really isolating, especially when you question your own role in what happened.

I hear you saying that you’re not sure how to express everything you're feeling, and that can make it even harder to process. Sometimes, it helps to talk about those thoughts more openly. I wonder if part of you might be feeling a deeper sadness or frustration than what you're able to put into words right now. What do you think?
vocal_descriptors: very high pitch, moderate volume, moderate-paced speech

client: Yeah, I think you’re right about feeling a mix of emotions. It’s just so confusing to look back and think about what went wrong.
